items.summary: Pike, sentenced to death over 1995 murder, had been granted stay of execution earlier on Wednesday The US supreme court is allowing Tennessee’s first execution of a woman in 200 years to go forward, vacating a last-minute stay issued by a lower court earlier in the day. Christa Pike, who was convicted of murder 30 years ago, was initially scheduled to die by lethal injection on Wednesday morning until her execution was halted hours earlier by a federal appeals court. In a 2-1 ruling, that court said the delay was necessary to assess whether Pike’s allegations of childhood sexual abuse were fully considered at her sentencing. The state governor and the supreme court had earlier refused calls for clemency. Continue reading...

items.title: ‘Godzilla’ of weight-loss drugs could provide other important health benefits
items.summary: Though not yet approved by any regulatory agency, retatrutide could help improve blood sugar levels and reduce inflammation The ‘Godzilla’ of weight-loss drugs could help improve blood sugar levels, reduce inflammation and cut a person’s body weight by a quarter, according to the largest study of its kind. Retatrutide mimics three key gut hormones that help control appetite, blood sugar and metabolism: GLP-1, GIP and glucagon. Unlike other drugs such as Wegovy, which primarily targets the GLP-1 pathway to suppress appetite, or Mounjaro, which contains GLP-1 plus GIP to control blood sugar levels, retatrutide also engages the glucagon receptor, which helps increase energy expenditure. articles.title: 개편 앞둔 공소청-중수청에 법무부-경찰까지 ‘수장 공백’
articles.snippet: 검찰청 폐지와 공소청·중대범죄수사청(중수청) 출범이 하루 앞으로 다가왔지만, 정작 두 기관 모두 ‘수장 공백’ 상태로 새 형사사법 체계 첫날을 맞게 됐다. 여기에 컨트롤 타워인 법무부 장관과 수사 주체인 경찰청장마저 공백 상태다. 결국 법무부와 공소청, 중수청, 경찰청 4곳 모두 직무대행 체제가 불가피해졌다. 기관장 임명을 위한 국회 인사청문회 절차에만 한 달 가까이 걸리기 때문이다. 30일 현재 형사사법 체계 개편에 관계된 주요 부처·기관 가운데 수장이 있는 곳은 한 곳도 없다. 우선 법무부는 장관 후보자로 지명됐던 더불어민주당 김승원 의원이 지난달 19일 자진 사퇴한 뒤 이진수 차관이 장관 직무대행을 맡고 있다. 공소청으로 탈바꿈하는 검찰은 검찰총장 공석이 1년 2개월 넘게 이어지고 있다. 지난달 22일 이정현 대검찰청 차장검사가 임명돼 검찰총장 직무대행을 맡았고, 공소청장 직무대행까지 이어 간다. 경찰 역시 지난달 1일 임명된 김종철 경찰청 차장의 청장 직무대행 체제다.

articles.snippet: 한국과 미국 정부가 에너지 분야 사업으로 추려진 한국의 대미투자 프로젝트를 공개했다. 1일 양국 정부가 발표한 한미 전략투자 프로젝트 추진계획에 따르면 대미투자 공식 1호 사업으로는 텍사스주 엔시날 가스복합화력발전소 사업을 확정했다. 후속 프로젝트로는 미국 내 대형 원전 8기 건설, 알래스카 액화천연가스(LNG) 프로젝트 추진을 논의한다. 이번 발표는 지난해 7월 한미 무역합의와 같은 해 11월 체결된 전략적 투자 양해각서(MOU)의 후속 조치다. 한미 전략투자법을 비롯한 관련 절차를 거쳐 에너지 등 전략산업의 공급망을 강화하고 양국 간 경제안보 협력을 확대하는 데 초점이 맞춰졌다.● 텍사스 가스복합화력 발전소에 223억 달러 투자대미 프로젝트 1호인 텍사스주 엔시날 가스복합화력발전소는 6.4GW(기가와트) 규모로 우선 1.9GW 규모의 가스터빈 발전소를 짓고 실제 수요와 경제성을 확인하며 나머지 설비를 추가하는 방식으로 진행된다. But then there were a few (not me) who welled up when he announced a commission on electoral reform. It was just the sheer shock of it: that we may finally have a prime minister who will follow through on his own long-held beliefs and remain loyal to his long-term support base, even if it makes him avoidable enemies and, medium-term, destroys Labour’s only-trodden path to victory. It felt a bit like slipping through time, and I couldn’t even tell you to when (definitely not the 1990s). Burnham’s support for proportional representation has always been extremely unusual for a Labour politician. To this day, he ascribes that to his experience of winning an election as mayor of Greater Manchester on a supplementary votes system, where people get to choose a first- and second-preference candidate. He said that campaigning under that system “finally aligned the conversation on the door with what people want from politics, which is about problem-solving first and foremost, not about point-scoring”. He went a bit further this morning, asking Nick Robinson on the Today programme: “Can we really watch a party with less than 30% walk into Downing Street?” Zoe Williams is a Guardian columnist Continue reading...

articles.title: I heard one thing loud and clear in Andy Burnham’s landmark speech: the left has won the arguments | Owen Jones
articles.snippet: The PM’s stated trajectory is a rebuke to past Tory and Labour governments. The challenge now is to make his project progressive in word and deed As Andy Burnham delivered his conference speech to the Labour faithful yesterday, it was hard not to recall Jeremy Corbyn’s words after the party’s shattering 2019 election defeat. “I am proud that on austerity, on corporate power, on inequality and the climate emergency,” he wrote for this publication, “we have won the arguments and rewritten the terms of political debate.” Given Boris Johnson’s 80-seat majority, widespread mockery ensued. But when it comes to rhetoric, who can now deny that the left has won the argument? A Labour prime minister has declared that “Britain has been on the wrong path for a long time”, listing five villains: “Deindustrialisation, deregulation, privatisation, austerity, Brexit.” His speech was infused with class politics, as he condemned a society “run for vested interests, not in the public interest, with power held in too few hands”.
